out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Previous submissions in PLUS did not successfully pass through plan review process for installation of grease trap/
violations.corrective_action: MANAGEMENT SUBMITTED HAMEND-2026-00461 FOR INSTALLATION OF GREASE TRAP. Management will monitor application for approval. Management will contact contractor to pull applicable permits for grease trap installation.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: A review of the menu finds that the facility is producing grease in quantities likely to contribute to the production of grease-laden wastewater. Therefore, the wastewater from warewashing is required to go through a grease trap. OBSERVED NO GREASE TRAP INSTALLED SINCE CHANGE OF OWNERSHIP INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. MANAGEMENT SUBMITTED HAMEND-2026-00461 ON 11/2/26. MANAGEMENT SHOULD MONITOR PROGRESS OF APPLICATION AND REACH OUT TO 703- 246-2201 WITH ANY ISSUES. MANAGEMENT WILL REACH OUT TO CONTRACTOR TO BEGIN PULLING PLUMBING PERMITS.
